tools.name: 42Crunch
tools.description: Audits REST API contracts for security issues and scans running APIs for conformance to their OpenAPI descriptions.
tools.purposeNotes: Discovery: API Scan generates valid and malformed REST requests and reports conformance and security findings. Verification / regression: Contract audits and defined conformance checks verify OpenAPI requirements alongside live generated probes.
tools.setupNotes: Provide an OpenAPI contract and, for API Scan, a live REST endpoint plus any authentication. A contract alone supports static audit; it is not sufficient for a live scan.

tools.name: 42Crunch IntelliJ OpenAPI Editor
tools.description: A JetBrains IDE extension that audits OpenAPI descriptions and runs API conformance and security scans against REST implementations.
tools.purposeNotes: Discovery: Run integrated API Scan to exercise a live REST API with generated conformance tests; editing and Audit alone do not qualify. Verification / regression: The editor verifies OpenAPI contracts and provides API Scan for generated live probes.
tools.setupNotes: Open an OpenAPI document in a JetBrains IDE. Live API Scan additionally requires a reachable target and scan configuration.

tools.name: 42Crunch VS Code OpenAPI Editor
tools.description: A VS Code extension that validates OpenAPI descriptions and provides REST API security audit and conformance scan integrations.
tools.purposeNotes: Discovery: Use the API Scan integration for generated live REST probes; static OpenAPI linting alone does not qualify. Verification / regression: The editor verifies OpenAPI contracts and provides API Scan for generated live probes.
tools.setupNotes: Open an OpenAPI document, or use API Contract Generator to convert a supported Postman collection or HAR into a contract. Live API Scan additionally needs a reachable target and scan configuration.

tools.name: @nest-openapi/mock
tools.description: Generates mock REST API responses from OpenAPI descriptions inside NestJS applications.
tools.purposeNotes: Verification / regression support: supplies controlled HTTP responses, test data, or recorded interactions for repeatable integration checks. This is supporting infrastructure, not a standalone test runner.
tools.setupNotes: Provide an OpenAPI description and configure the NestJS integration to serve mock responses; this generates mocks rather than testing a live target.

tools.name: @nest-openapi/validator
tools.description: NestJS integration that validates REST requests and responses against an OpenAPI description using Ajv.
tools.purposeNotes: Verification / regression: checks defined OpenAPI contracts, schemas, examples, compatibility rules, or request/response expectations. Static validators check description files rather than executing live API tests.
tools.setupNotes: Requires both an OpenAPI description and HTTP requests/responses from a configured NestJS application.

tools.name: Advanced REST Client
tools.description: A desktop HTTP client for composing REST requests, inspecting responses, and organizing reusable API requests.
tools.notes: This entry covers the ARC Electron desktop application. Current maintenance status and a dedicated CI runner have not been confirmed.
tools.purposeNotes: Verification support: sends defined REST requests for inspection or reuse. Manual request composition and OpenAPI import do not constitute automated discovery or a regression test suite.
tools.setupNotes: Compose an HTTP request, import a cURL command, or load supported request collections. Authentication and request data must be supplied where needed.

tools.name: aiopenapi3
tools.description: A Python client library that calls REST services from OpenAPI descriptions and validates request and response data with Pydantic.
tools.purposeNotes: Verification / regression: checks defined OpenAPI contracts, schemas, examples, compatibility rules, or request/response expectations. Static validators check description files rather than executing live API tests.
tools.setupNotes: Load an OpenAPI description in Python, then supply operation parameters and any target authentication to call the REST service.

tools.name: API Insights (Treblle)
tools.description: Reviews an OpenAPI description and a server request to assess REST API design, security, and response performance. These checks do not constitute a load test.
tools.purposeNotes: Verification / regression: checks defined OpenAPI contracts, schemas, examples, compatibility rules, or request/response expectations. Static validators check description files rather than executing live API tests.
tools.setupNotes: Upload an OpenAPI description. Endpoint reachability and a server request are used for runtime insights; uploading a contract is not traffic recording.

tools.name: api-smart-diff
tools.description: Compares OpenAPI descriptions and classifies changes to help identify REST API contract compatibility risks.
tools.purposeNotes: Verification / regression: checks defined OpenAPI contracts, schemas, examples, compatibility rules, or request/response expectations. Static validators check description files rather than executing live API tests.
tools.setupNotes: Requires baseline and candidate API description documents for comparison; no running REST server is needed for static diffing.

tools.name: APIDevTools Swagger Parser
tools.description: Parses and validates Swagger and OpenAPI descriptions, resolves references, and bundles contracts for REST API verification workflows.
tools.purposeNotes: Verification / regression: checks defined OpenAPI contracts, schemas, examples, compatibility rules, or request/response expectations. Static validators check description files rather than executing live API tests.
tools.setupNotes: Supply a Swagger/OpenAPI document or its URL to the JavaScript parser/validator; this checks the description rather than running API requests.

tools.name: Apidog
tools.description: Design and explore REST APIs, validate responses against schemas, build automated test scenarios, and simulate services with mocks.
features: OpenAPI-based API design and response validation
Chained test scenarios and data-driven runs
tools.notes: Free and paid plans are available. Hosted, local, and on-premises capabilities depend on the selected edition and execution mode.
tools.purposeNotes: Discovery: Generate negative and boundary test cases with AI, then execute them to investigate REST API behavior; AI access may depend on plan. Verification / regression: Saved requests, scripted assertions, or configured scenarios support repeatable verification and regression checks.
tools.setupNotes: Compose requests or import supported cURL, OpenAPI, collection, or HAR data. Imported requests are a starting point; tests and authentication may need configuration.

tools.name: APIFuzzer
tools.description: Generates and executes fuzz tests from Swagger or OpenAPI descriptions to discover failures in REST API implementations.
tools.purposeNotes: Discovery: Mutate OpenAPI-derived request parameters, execute the variations, and inspect failures without authoring a regression suite. This classification covers the exploration engine; rerunning it in CI alone does not establish a maintained regression suite.
tools.setupNotes: Requires a Swagger/OpenAPI description and a reachable REST target. Configure authentication and fuzzing options before running.

tools.name: APIGit
tools.description: A Git-based API collaboration platform with REST requests, automated tests, and mock servers for checking API behavior.
tools.purposeNotes: Verification / regression: authored scenarios, saved requests, assertions, or recorded baselines check defined REST API behavior.
tools.setupNotes: Design/import an OpenAPI description or compose REST requests in the workspace; mocks and automated tests need their respective configuration.

tools.name: APIMatic OpenAPI Linter - GitHub App

tools.setupNotes: Provide OpenAPI files in a GitHub repository and configure the app to validate them during pull requests.

tools.name: APIQuality

tools.name: Apitally

tools.name: arazzo-cli

tools.name: Assertible

tools.name: Routebase
tools.description: An OpenAPI-oriented platform with REST API mocks, contract tests, and drift monitoring tied to API descriptions.
tools.purposeNotes: Verification / regression: checks defined OpenAPI contracts, schemas, examples, compatibility rules, or request/response expectations. Static validators check description files rather than executing live API tests.
tools.setupNotes: Start from an OpenAPI contract in the platform; live contract/drift checks additionally require target and environment configuration.

tools.name: Rswag
tools.description: Extends Rails RSpec request tests with an OpenAPI-oriented DSL to exercise REST operations and validate responses.
tools.purposeNotes: Verification / regression: checks defined OpenAPI contracts, schemas, examples, compatibility rules, or request/response expectations. Static validators check description files rather than executing live API tests.
tools.setupNotes: Author Rails/RSpec request specs with the Rswag DSL; those tests describe requests and expected responses and can generate OpenAPI output.

tools.name: Scalar
tools.description: An API client and interactive OpenAPI reference interface for composing REST requests and inspecting responses.
tools.purposeNotes: Verification support: sends defined REST requests for inspection or reuse. Manual request composition and OpenAPI import do not constitute automated discovery or a regression test suite.
tools.setupNotes: Use the API client to compose/import requests or load OpenAPI for the reference console. Authentication and environment values may still need setup.

tools.name: Schemathesis
tools.description: Generate property-based REST API tests from OpenAPI schemas to find server errors, invalid-input behavior, and response conformance issues.
tools.notes: REST testing requires an OpenAPI specification. The entry covers the open-source test runner.
tools.purposeNotes: Discovery: Generate and execute property-based REST requests from OpenAPI and investigate minimized failure examples. This classification covers the exploration engine; rerunning it in CI alone does not establish a maintained regression suite.
tools.setupNotes: REST testing requires an OpenAPI schema, supplied as a file, URL, or application integration, plus a running/loaded API and any required authentication.

tools.name: SchemaWatch
tools.description: A Python command-line tool that compares OpenAPI descriptions to detect breaking REST API changes, with machine-readable reports and CI exit codes.
tools.purposeNotes: Verification / regression: checks defined OpenAPI contracts, schemas, examples, compatibility rules, or request/response expectations. Static validators check description files rather than executing live API tests.
tools.setupNotes: Requires baseline and candidate OpenAPI description files to detect breaking changes; a running REST target is not needed.

tools.name: SoapUI
tools.description: An open-source desktop application for REST API functional tests, response assertions, security scans, load tests, and HTTP service mocks.
features: REST request steps and response assertions
Security scans and basic load testing
HTTP mocking and command-line test execution
tools.notes: This entry covers SoapUI Open Source. ReadyAPI is a separate commercial platform with additional automation and reporting capabilities.
tools.purposeNotes: Discovery: Use the Fuzzing Security Scan to mutate REST request parameters and investigate unexpected responses; ordinary replay alone does not qualify. Verification / regression: Saved requests, scripted assertions, or configured scenarios support repeatable verification and regression checks.
tools.setupNotes: Create REST request steps, import supported API descriptions, or capture HTTP requests through the recorder. Add assertions and configure security scans separately.

tools.name: Speakeasy OpenAPI
tools.description: Go libraries and command-line tools that validate OpenAPI descriptions and prepare REST API contracts for downstream workflows.
tools.purposeNotes: Verification / regression: checks defined OpenAPI contracts, schemas, examples, compatibility rules, or request/response expectations. Static validators check description files rather than executing live API tests.
tools.setupNotes: Supply OpenAPI description documents to the Go library or CLI for validation and document processing.

tools.name: Specmatic
tools.description: Uses OpenAPI descriptions as executable REST API contracts for provider conformance tests and service virtualization.
tools.purposeNotes: Discovery: Enable generative contract testing to exercise REST endpoints with generated positive and negative input combinations. Verification / regression: Contract tests verify specified request/response behavior; generative mode also explores positive and negative combinations.
tools.setupNotes: Provide an OpenAPI contract for REST contract testing/mocking. Testing additionally requires a reachable implementation; generative mode and authentication are configured separately.

tools.name: SpecShield
tools.description: Compares OpenAPI descriptions and consumer contracts to detect REST API compatibility problems and gate deployment workflows.
tools.purposeNotes: Verification / regression: checks defined OpenAPI contracts, schemas, examples, compatibility rules, or request/response expectations. Static validators check description files rather than executing live API tests.
tools.setupNotes: Provide OpenAPI descriptions/consumer contracts for compatibility checks, or import an externally recorded HAR to derive a consumer contract. HAR import does not itself record traffic.

tools.name: Spectator
tools.description: Laravel test helpers that validate REST API requests and responses against OpenAPI descriptions.
tools.purposeNotes: Verification / regression: checks defined OpenAPI contracts, schemas, examples, compatibility rules, or request/response expectations. Static validators check description files rather than executing live API tests.
tools.setupNotes: Requires an OpenAPI description and request/response interactions inside a Laravel test suite.

tools.name: Spectral
tools.description: Lints OpenAPI descriptions with configurable rulesets, including rules for REST API design consistency and security review.
tools.purposeNotes: Verification / regression: checks defined OpenAPI contracts, schemas, examples, compatibility rules, or request/response expectations. Static validators check description files rather than executing live API tests.
tools.setupNotes: Supply an OpenAPI description and a built-in/custom ruleset. The linter checks JSON/YAML documents rather than sending REST requests.

tools.name: StackHawk HawkScan
tools.description: Scans running REST APIs for vulnerabilities and uses OpenAPI descriptions to discover endpoints and configure authenticated API testing.
tools.purposeNotes: Discovery: Run active API security scans against OpenAPI-discovered REST endpoints and investigate generated vulnerability probes. This classification covers the exploration engine; rerunning it in CI alone does not establish a maintained regression suite.
tools.setupNotes: Configure the application URL and a REST endpoint-discovery source such as OpenAPI or HAR. API paths, authentication, and scan scope need configuration; a bare URL may not discover all API operations.

tools.name: Step CI
tools.description: Runs declarative multi-step HTTP API tests, with OpenAPI-based response validation and workflows for REST API checks in CI.
tools.purposeNotes: Verification / regression: checks defined OpenAPI contracts, schemas, examples, compatibility rules, or request/response expectations. Static validators check description files rather than executing live API tests.
tools.setupNotes: Write a YAML/JSON test workflow or generate a starting workflow from OpenAPI. Configure checks, input values, and credentials before execution.

tools.name: Stoplight Elements
tools.description: Embeddable OpenAPI reference components with a Try It console for manually calling REST endpoints and inspecting responses.
tools.purposeNotes: Verification support: sends defined REST requests for inspection or reuse. Manual request composition and OpenAPI import do not constitute automated discovery or a regression test suite.
tools.setupNotes: Load an OpenAPI description into the reference component, then provide request parameters and authentication to use Try It.

tools.name: Stoplight Studio
tools.description: An OpenAPI design environment with linting and mock APIs for checking REST contracts and trying client integrations.
tools.purposeNotes: Verification / regression: checks defined OpenAPI contracts, schemas, examples, compatibility rules, or request/response expectations. Static validators check description files rather than executing live API tests.
tools.setupNotes: Create or import an OpenAPI description for validation and mocks. This is not an HTTP traffic recorder.

tools.name: super-linter
tools.description: A repository linting workflow that can run OpenAPI checks with Spectral as part of REST API contract verification in CI.
tools.purposeNotes: Verification / regression: checks defined OpenAPI contracts, schemas, examples, compatibility rules, or request/response expectations. Static validators check description files rather than executing live API tests.
tools.setupNotes: Provide OpenAPI files in a repository and configure the linting workflow/rules; this validates descriptions rather than running API endpoints.

tools.name: Swagger Editor
tools.description: A browser-based OpenAPI editor with description validation and interactive API exploration for checking REST contracts and requests.
tools.purposeNotes: Verification / regression: checks defined OpenAPI contracts, schemas, examples, compatibility rules, or request/response expectations. Static validators check description files rather than executing live API tests.
tools.setupNotes: Create or load a Swagger/OpenAPI description. Interactive requests additionally need operation inputs, authentication, and a reachable server.

tools.name: Swagger Parser (Java)
tools.description: A Java library that reads and validates OpenAPI descriptions and reports issues in REST API contracts.
tools.purposeNotes: Verification / regression: checks defined OpenAPI contracts, schemas, examples, compatibility rules, or request/response expectations. Static validators check description files rather than executing live API tests.
tools.setupNotes: Provide an OpenAPI description to the Java parser for parsing, reference resolution, and validation.

tools.name: Swagger UI
tools.description: An interactive, OpenAPI-powered REST API explorer for sending requests, supplying authentication, and inspecting live responses directly in a browser.
features: Interactive API documentation generated from OpenAPI
Try it out requests with parameters, bodies, and authentication
Live response status, headers, and body inspection
tools.notes: Requires an OpenAPI definition. This entry covers the open-source Swagger UI component; commercial Swagger products have separate plans and capabilities.
tools.purposeNotes: Verification support: sends defined REST requests for inspection or reuse. Manual request composition and OpenAPI import do not constitute automated discovery or a regression test suite.
tools.setupNotes: Provide an OpenAPI description to populate the REST explorer; supply operation values and authentication before trying live calls.

tools.name: swagger-coverage-cli
tools.description: Measures REST API operation and response coverage by comparing OpenAPI descriptions with Postman collections or Newman reports.
tools.purposeNotes: Verification / regression: checks defined OpenAPI contracts, schemas, examples, compatibility rules, or request/response expectations. Static validators check description files rather than executing live API tests.
tools.setupNotes: Requires an OpenAPI description plus Postman collection data or a Newman execution report to calculate coverage; a specification alone is insufficient.

tools.name: SwaggerHub
tools.description: An API design platform with OpenAPI validation, standardization checks, and REST API mocking for reviewing contracts and integrations.
tools.notes: SwaggerHub capabilities are now presented as part of the Swagger platform. This entry covers API design validation and mocking.
tools.purposeNotes: Verification / regression: checks defined OpenAPI contracts, schemas, examples, compatibility rules, or request/response expectations. Static validators check description files rather than executing live API tests.
tools.setupNotes: Create or import an OpenAPI description for contract validation, governance, and mocks; execution capabilities depend on the selected platform component.

tools.name: Tavern
tools.description: Define REST API test scenarios in YAML and run them with pytest, with chained stages, response validation, and Python extensions.
features: Declarative YAML request and response tests
pytest integration and Python custom validation
tools.notes: Also supports other protocols. This entry covers its REST API testing workflow.
tools.purposeNotes: Verification / regression: authored scenarios, saved requests, assertions, or recorded baselines check defined REST API behavior.
tools.setupNotes: Write YAML REST test stages and assertions for pytest, with target URLs, input data, and authentication configured as needed.

tools.name: Tcases for OpenAPI
tools.description: Generates REST API test cases from OpenAPI descriptions and checks specification consistency with semantic linting.
tools.purposeNotes: Discovery: Generate input combinations and execute generated REST tests against a live API to investigate schema and implementation edge cases. Verification / regression: Generated executable test cases can be retained with defined expectations for repeated verification.
tools.setupNotes: Provide an OpenAPI description to generate input combinations and tests. Running the generated tests requires a target API and execution configuration.

tools.name: Thunder Client
tools.description: A REST API client inside VS Code and JetBrains editors, with local collections, visual response assertions, and a CLI for automated runs.
features: Local collections and CLI collection runs
tools.notes: The free tier has limits. CLI and CI/CD execution require a paid plan. Announced performance testing is not counted as an available capability.
tools.purposeNotes: Verification / regression: authored scenarios, saved requests, assertions, or recorded baselines check defined REST API behavior.
tools.setupNotes: Compose requests or import supported cURL, OpenAPI, and collection formats. CLI and other capabilities depend on the edition.

tools.name: Treblle
tools.description: Captures REST API request and response telemetry through SDK integrations to investigate errors, latency, and API behavior.
tools.purposeNotes: Passive REST API telemetry and analytics help investigate traffic, but the listed capabilities do not establish an active discovery test or a defined regression check.
tools.setupNotes: Integrate a Treblle SDK/middleware in the application to capture request/response telemetry. Sending a cURL without that integration is not traffic capture.

tools.name: vacuum
tools.description: Validates and lints OpenAPI descriptions with Spectral-compatible rulesets to check REST API contract quality.
tools.purposeNotes: Verification / regression: checks defined OpenAPI contracts, schemas, examples, compatibility rules, or request/response expectations. Static validators check description files rather than executing live API tests.
tools.setupNotes: Provide an OpenAPI description and optional ruleset/configuration for static validation and linting.

tools.name: vacuum OWASP Ruleset
tools.description: Applies OWASP-oriented static security rules to OpenAPI descriptions using vacuum. It reviews contracts rather than probing live REST endpoints.
tools.purposeNotes: Verification / regression: checks defined OpenAPI contracts, schemas, examples, compatibility rules, or request/response expectations. Static validators check description files rather than executing live API tests.
tools.setupNotes: Provide an OpenAPI description and enable the vacuum OWASP ruleset. This reviews the contract without recording or executing REST traffic.

tools.name: vREST NG
tools.description: An API test automation application that imports OpenAPI descriptions and validates REST responses with assertions and JSON Schema checks.
tools.purposeNotes: Verification / regression: checks defined OpenAPI contracts, schemas, examples, compatibility rules, or request/response expectations. Static validators check description files rather than executing live API tests.
tools.setupNotes: Create REST test cases or import Swagger/OpenAPI and supported Postman collections. The CLI runs configured tests; schema and generation features can depend on edition.

tools.name: WireMock
tools.description: Create controllable HTTP service doubles to test REST integrations without relying on live downstream dependencies.
tools.notes: The open-source server and WireMock Cloud have different deployment options and terms.
tools.purposeNotes: Verification / regression support: supplies controlled HTTP responses, test data, or recorded interactions for repeatable integration checks. This is supporting infrastructure, not a standalone test runner.
tools.setupNotes: Define HTTP stub mappings in JSON/code or record interactions through the configured proxy. Recording needs a real upstream service; mock playback is a separate step.

tools.name: WireMock Cloud
tools.description: A hosted API simulation service with stateful REST API mocks, OpenAPI import, and configurable responses for integration testing.
tools.purposeNotes: Verification / regression support: supplies controlled HTTP responses, test data, or recorded interactions for repeatable integration checks. This is supporting infrastructure, not a standalone test runner.
tools.setupNotes: Create mock request/response mappings, import OpenAPI, or record a real upstream service with the platform's recorder. This prepares mocks rather than testing a target automatically.

tools.name: Wiretap
tools.description: A validation proxy that checks REST requests and responses against OpenAPI descriptions and captures traffic for debugging and mock workflows.
tools.purposeNotes: Verification / regression: checks defined OpenAPI contracts, schemas, examples, compatibility rules, or request/response expectations. Static validators check description files rather than executing live API tests.
tools.setupNotes: Supply OpenAPI for validation/mocks, route real HTTP traffic through the proxy, or replay a HAR. Live capture and HAR replay are separate entry paths.

tools.name: WuppieFuzz
tools.description: A coverage-guided REST API fuzzer that uses OpenAPI descriptions to generate requests and discover implementation failures.
tools.purposeNotes: Discovery: Use coverage-guided REST request generation and mutation to discover failures in the target implementation. This classification covers the exploration engine; rerunning it in CI alone does not establish a maintained regression suite.
tools.setupNotes: Provide an OpenAPI description, target, and configuration for stateful fuzzing. Coverage-guided instrumentation depends on the chosen testing mode.

tools.name: Yaak
tools.description: A local-first REST API client with desktop and command-line interfaces, request chaining, environments, and Git-friendly workspace files.
features: Desktop and CLI access to the same requests
tools.notes: Source code is MIT licensed. Official prebuilt binaries are free for personal use; work use requires a commercial license after the trial.
tools.purposeNotes: Verification support: sends defined REST requests for inspection or reuse. Manual request composition and OpenAPI import do not constitute automated discovery or a regression test suite.
tools.setupNotes: Compose REST requests or import supported cURL, OpenAPI, and request collections. Configure environment values and authentication for live calls.

tools.name: ZAP
tools.description: A dynamic security testing tool with HTTP inspection, automated scanning, and API scanning workflows for REST services.
tools.notes: Configure authentication and API definitions for the target. Scan only systems you are authorized to test.
tools.purposeNotes: Discovery: Import REST API definitions and run active security probes; passive inspection alone does not qualify. This classification covers the exploration engine; rerunning it in CI alone does not establish a maintained regression suite.
tools.setupNotes: Import OpenAPI or discover endpoints by proxying existing HTTP/API tests through ZAP. A target URL starts scanning, but API endpoint discovery and authentication still need configuration.
